.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, 'Noto Sans Regular';}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._look_sec ._tag {position:absolute; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:2.26667vw; width:40vw; color:#fff;}

._look_sec ._label {display:flex; align-items:center; height:6.4vw; padding:0 2.66667vw; border-radius:8vw; background:#3e4f5b; font-size:2.66667vw; font-weight:600; line-height:3.2vw; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#fff;}
._api_prd_sec ._cate_title ._txt {margin:0 1.6vw 0 1.33333vw; font-size:5.33333vw; font-weight:700; line-height:6.4vw; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#161616; white-space:nowrap;}
._api_prd_sec ._item ._thumb {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:41.33333vw; height:41.33333vw; background:#e5e5e5; overflow:hidden;}

._api_prd_sec ._item ._brand {display:block; margin-top:2.66667vw; font-size:3.46667vw; font-weight:700; line-height:4.13333vw; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#000; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;}

._api_prd_sec ._item ._product {display:-webkit-box; margin-top:1.06667vw; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; line-height:4vw; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#000; word-break:break-word;}
._api_prd_sec ._item ._price_wrap {display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.8vw; margin-top:2vw; font-size:3.46667vw; line-height:4.13333vw; white-space:nowrap;}
._gift_sec ._gift_list ._thumb {position:relative; display:block; width:41.33333vw; height:41.73333vw; border-radius:2.66667vw; background:#e5e5e5; overflow:hidden;}

._gift_sec ._gift_list ._badge {position:absolute; left:2vw; top:2vw; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:10.66667vw; height:10.66667vw; padding:0.53333vw 0.66667vw 0; border-radius:50%; background:#dd153e; font-size:2.4vw; font-weight:800; line-height:2.66667vw; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:#fff; overflow-wrap:anywhere;}
._gift_sec ._note {margin-top:9.33333vw; font-family:'Noto Sans Regular', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size:3.33333vw; line-height:4vw; color:#a6b0b6;}

._gift_sec ._more_bar {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:100%; min-height:14.66667vw; padding:0 2.66667vw; background:#05446d; text-align:center; font-size:4vw; font-weight:500; line-height:4.8vw; letter-spacing:-0.03em; color:#fff;}
